Memory capacity is separate for each platform and cannot be pooled. The supplied tables describe the current plan; use their rows directly. For each item, sum the signed benefit components after converting amount * usd_cents_numerator / denominator using fx. This is the benefit per unit in USD cents. Deduct item_fee once for each option with positive quantity. Convert GB to MB using 1000 MB per GB. Choose zero for unauthorized options. For any other option, choose zero or an integer from minimum_lot to maximum_order. Sum the signed capacity_ledger entries separately by resource; the total usage of that resource must stay within this amount. Across all options, each category must meet its lower and upper quantity limits; category activation_fee_cents is deducted once if used. The incompatible table forbids joint selection, while requires means positive quantity of item_ref needs positive quantity of prerequisite_ref, without proportional quantities. Each bundle row contributes bonus_cents once if both options are selected; if either is unselected or unauthorized the bonus is zero. Report the maximum net benefit in USD cents. All fixed fees and bonuses are in the same unit.

    for (_, row) in bundle_frame.iterrows():
        i = row['item_a']
        j = row['item_b']
        B.append((i, j))
        b_ij[i, j] = int(row['bonus_cents'])
    inc_frame = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_6_view_0']
    Q = []
    for (_, row) in inc_frame.iterrows():
        i = row['item_a']
        j = row['item_b']
        Q.append((i, j))
    req_frame = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_10_view_0']
    P = []
    for (_, row) in req_frame.iterrows():
        i = row['item_ref']
        k = row['prerequisite_ref']
        P.append((i, k))
    comp_frame = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_0_view_0']
    b_i = {i: 0.0 for i in I}
    for (_, row) in comp_frame.iterrows():
        item_ref = row['item_ref']
        if item_ref not in b_i:
            continue
        amount = float(row['amount'])
        currency = row['currency']
        if currency not in fx:
            raise ValueError(f'Missing FX rate for currency {currency}')
        b_i[item_ref] += amount * fx[currency]
    fee_frame = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_8_view_0']
    f_item = {}
    for (_, row) in fee_frame.iterrows():
        item_ref = row['item_ref']
        f_item[item_ref] = int(row['activation_fee_cents'])
    for i in I:
        if i not in f_item:
            f_item[i] = 0
    usage_frame = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_11_view_0']
    u_ir = {(i, r): 0.0 for i in I for r in R}
    for (_, row) in usage_frame.iterrows():
        i = row['item_ref']
        r = row['resource']
        if i not in I or r not in R:
            continue
        amount = float(row['amount'])
        unit = row['unit']
        if unit.casefold() == 'gb':
            amount = amount * 1000.0
        u_ir[i, r] = amount
    K_r = {r: 0.0 for r in R}
    for (_, row) in res_frame.iterrows():
        r = row['resource']
        amount = float(row['amount'])
        unit = row['unit']
        if unit.casefold() == 'gb':
            amount = amount * 1000.0
        K_r[r] += amount
    S_c = {c: [] for c in C}
    for i in I:
        S_c[c_i[i]].append(i)
    m = gp.Model('GameEditionAllocation')
    x_vars = m.addVars(I, vtype=gp.GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name='')
    y_vars = m.addVars(I, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name='')
    z_vars = m.addVars(C, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name='')
    w_vars = m.addVars(B, vtype=gp.GRB.BINARY, name='')
    for i in I:
        if a_i[i] == 0:
            m.addConstr(x_vars[i] == 0, name=f'unauth_{i}')
            m.addConstr(y_vars[i] == 0, name=f'unauth_y_{i}')
        else:
            m.addConstr(x_vars[i] <= qmax_i[i] * y_vars[i], name=f'xmax_{i}')
            m.addConstr(x_vars[i] >= qmin_i[i] * y_vars[i], name=f'xmin_{i}')
    for c in C:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((x_vars[i] for i in S_c[c])) >= Cmin[c], name=f'cat_min_{c}')
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((x_vars[i] for i in S_c[c])) <= Cmax[c], name=f'cat_max_{c}')
        for i in S_c[c]:
            m.addConstr(x_vars[i] <= qmax_i[i] * z_vars[c], name=f'cat_act_{i}')
    for r in R:
        m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((u_ir[i, r] * x_vars[i] for i in I)) <= K_r[r], name=f'res_{r}')
    for (i, j) in Q:
        if i in I and j in I:
            m.addConstr(y_vars[i] + y_vars[j] <= 1, name=f'incomp_{i}_{j}')
    for (i, k) in P:
        if i in I and k in I:
            m.addConstr(y_vars[i] <= y_vars[k], name=f'req_{i}_{k}')
    for (i, j) in B:
        if i in I and j in I:
            m.addConstr(w_vars[i, j] <= y_vars[i], name=f'wleqyi_{i}_{j}')
            m.addConstr(w_vars[i, j] <= y_vars[j], name=f'wleqyj_{i}_{j}')
            m.addConstr(w_vars[i, j] >= y_vars[i] + y_vars[j] - 1, name=f'wgeqsum_{i}_{j}')
    obj = gp.quicksum((b_i[i] * x_vars[i] - f_item[i] * y_vars[i] for i in I)) + gp.quicksum((b_ij[i, j] * w_vars[i, j] for (i, j) in B)) - gp.quicksum((f_cat[c] * z_vars[c] for c in C))
    m.setObjective(obj, gp.GRB.MAXIMIZE)
    m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
    m.optimize()
    return m
